title: Hasse-Davenport collapses T_h to the autocorrelation of ONE shifted Gauss-sum sequence (GL(1) monodromy), so the m-fold largesieve dimension wall is mis-applied to the tangent face
evidence: Two exact probes at proper-subgroup primes p~n^beta (beta=4..4.5), n=2^a, n<<sqrt(p), m=(p-1)/n large (n=8/16/32; m=516..32769). probe_C012_autocorr_dimension.py CONFIRMS the identity-side claim: house = A_h autocorrelation (FFT-correlation def verified to 1e-13 vs brute; |tau_j|=sqrt(p) flat to 1e-12; tau_0=-1). It is NOT coherent: Amax/(m p) -> 0 (0.109->0.017), TmaxA/sqrt(p) -> 0, so T-house is sqrt(n log m)-scale not sqrt(p). The DIRECT Gauss-period house B (computed independently, NOT via the identity) matches TmaxA exactly and B/sqrt(n log m) = 1.07,1.20,1.26 (GROWS, does not settle). BUT probe_C012_dimension_crux.py REFUTES the decisive 'one-sequence / GL(1) conductor O(1)' claim: the i-indexed sequence v_i = tau_i/tau_{i+h} underlying T_h=(1/m)sum_i J(chi^i,chi^h) is effectively FULL-RANK random-like, NOT a rank-1 geometric (single-Kummer-sheaf) object. Measured: participation-ratio PR/m = 0.71,0.81,0.81 (rank-1 would give ~1/m->0); lag-1 autocorr mean_r1 = 0.166,0.080,0.040 -> 0 (rank-1 would give 1); consecutive-ratio coherence |mean(v_{i+1}conj v_i)| = 0.109,0.042,0.049 (geometric/rank-1 would give 1); spectral spike |FFT(v)|max/sqrt(m) = 4.95,6.77,8.89 vs the rank-1 value sqrt(m)=22.7,64,181 (so the i-energy is spread over ~all m frequencies, the signature of m independent phases, not one spike). maxS/sqrt(m log m)=1.68,2.05,2.56 (same drifting sqrt(n log m)-class constant as every other face). Conclusion: the shift-by-h is a shift in the character lattice Z/m, not a geometric Frobenius shift on one curve; J(chi^i,chi^h) over varying i is a family of m DISTINCT Kummer/Jacobi sheaves -- exactly the m-dimensional family W-largesieve addresses -- so the dimension wall is CORRECTLY applied, not mis-applied.
honest_note: The descriptive half of C012 is correct and useful: the identity T_h = (tau_h/(m p)) A_h is real (in-tree I4 + Mathlib jacobiSum_mul_nontrivial), and the house is genuinely this autocorrelation at sqrt(n log m) scale (probe-confirmed against the direct house). What is REFUTED is the load-bearing inference -- that the autocorrelation is a SINGLE GL(1) sequence of conductor O(1) in i, hence outside the m-fold largesieve obstruction. Numerically the i-sequence is full-rank/random-like by four independent measures, so collapsing to 'one shifted Gauss sequence' does NOT reduce the effective dimension and does NOT make the cancellation tractable; it re-encodes the same m-term square-root-cancellation problem. This welds back to W-BGK / W-largesieve. The probe measures effective dimension/coherence numerically; it does not constitute a sheaf-theoretic monodromy computation, but the rank/coherence/spectral signatures are unambiguous and exact (no sampling). NOT a closure; this is a refutation of the reframing's escape value, to be logged in DISPROOF_LOG.
wall: W-largesieve (and equivalently W-BGK): the i-sequence tau_i/tau_{i+h} is effectively full-rank (PR/m~0.8), so T_h = (1/m) sum_i J(chi^i,chi^h) remains an m-term random-cancellation average over m distinct Kummer sheaves; the largesieve m-fold dimension obstruction applies as stated.
